article: Delete local and remote Git tags
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; checked Git command syntax, local versus remote effects, terminology, references, metadata and translated caution text.
findings: Updated lastmod to the review date across all 13 editions while preserving the original publication date (2022-10-02).
Confirmed local deletion with `git tag -d <tag>`, remote listing with `git ls-remote --tags --refs <remote>`, and remote deletion with `git push <remote> --delete <tag>`.
Clarified that `origin` is an example remote name and must be replaced when the configured remote has another name.
Added that deleting a tag removes the tag reference but does not directly delete the commit or rewrite other branches; collaborators retain their local tag references until they remove them.
Checked the official Git manuals for tag listing, local deletion, and remote deletion.
